answer: Admit agents through a congestion-priced lagoon: a fixed pool of identity slots where each entrant auctions for one, so the slot price rises as demand nears capacity. Honest agents buy one slot once and keep it; an attacker running N puppets must win N separate auctions at market price, paying full cost per identity with no bulk discount. Each sealed bid is hashed into a basalt record, an immutable entry nobody can forge, and the summit price reached by the last accepted bid sets the fee every later entrant must match, so fake inflow stops paying.
